1.head: Cool and clear.
1.body: Peak desert-camping season; perfect for the dunes and the north.

2.head: Mild days, cool nights.
2.body: The best light of the year at the Inland Sea.

3.head: Spring.
3.body: Warm days, last weeks of desert camping, migrating birds in the mangroves.

4.head: Warming up.
4.body: Mornings outdoors, museums at midday. Turtle nesting begins.

5.head: Hot afternoons.
5.body: Early starts and sea breezes. Turtle nesting nights.

6.head: Summer begins.
6.body: Whale shark season opens off the north-east coast.

7.head: Peak summer.
7.body: Whale sharks at the surface; dawn and after-dark plans.

8.head: Peak summer.
8.body: Whale sharks, summer offers and indoor worlds.

9.head: Late summer.
9.body: Final weeks of whale shark season.

10.head: Shoulder season.
10.body: The heat breaks; the desert opens up again.

11.head: Race month.
11.body: Night racing at Lusail and the start of camping season.

12.head: Festive and cool.
12.body: Desert nights, National Day celebrations, busy calendar.

climate.1: Cool and pleasant, highs around 22°C. Beaches, desert and outdoor plans work all day.
climate.2: Cool and pleasant, highs around 23°C. Beaches, desert and outdoor plans work all day.
climate.3: Warm, highs around 27°C. Outdoor plans and beaches work all day.
climate.4: Warm to hot, highs around 32°C. Outdoors is best in the morning and late afternoon.
climate.5: Hot, highs around 38°C. Keep outdoor plans to early morning and after sunset; midday indoors.
climate.6: Very hot and humid, highs of 40°C or more. Avoid midday sun, beach afternoons and long outdoor walks; plan dawn, after-dark and indoor experiences.
climate.7: Very hot and humid, highs of 40°C or more. Avoid midday sun, beach afternoons and long outdoor walks; plan dawn, after-dark and indoor experiences.
climate.8: Very hot and humid, highs of 40°C or more. Avoid midday sun, beach afternoons and long outdoor walks; plan dawn, after-dark and indoor experiences.
climate.9: Very hot and humid, highs near 40°C. Avoid midday sun, beach afternoons and long outdoor walks; plan dawn, after-dark and indoor experiences.
climate.10: Hot, highs around 35°C. Outdoors early and late; midday indoors.
climate.11: Warm and pleasant, highs around 29°C. Good beach and desert weather.
climate.12: Mild, highs around 24°C. Great for the desert, beaches and evenings outside.
